listing.name: SEED Reporter
listing.summary: Displays information about a sector seed - which includes points-of-interest locations like Domain-era Cryosleepers, Coronal Hypershunts (and their defender variants), and more - upon loading a new game or running the RunSEEDReport command.
listing.aiSummary: Adds the ability to display information about a sector seed upon loading a new game or when running a command on an existing save.

description:
SEED Reporter

Requires

Console Commands

!

Includes

LunaLib

support

Safe to add to existing saves, and safe to remove from existing saves

Mod details

This utility mod adds the ability to

display information about a sector seed

upon loading a new game or when running the

RunSEEDReport

command on an existing save. The reported information includes

the location of Coronal Hypershunts

(and their defender variants),

Domain-era Cryosleepers

,

exceptional officer pods

, and even

specific star systems or planets

(via configurable search settings in this mod's

seedreporterSettings.json

).

Plus, this mod supports seed-hunting efforts by adding a

new game option that completely bypasses the time-skip step

- resulting in faster new game creation - and by

automatically saving seeds with remarkable features

to a file in Starsector's

saves/common

folder. A basic AutoHotkey script is included in the mod download to constantly create new games in Starsector without player intervention; combined with the automatic seed-saving, this mod will help you find your perfect seed in no time!

*

*

Targeted towards vanilla or vanilla-adjacent games; reliablity of seed information

not guaranteed

when running any mod that interferes with procedural generation!

Additional information (recommended to read!)Upon loading a new game, and using the original settings, the mod will provide information about the following points-of-interest (and more!):

Star system containing the Sentinel planetNameless RockDomain-era CryosleepersDomain-era MothershipsFully-operational Remnant battlestationsInactive GatesLegion (XIV) wrecksStar systems that fulfill specific criteria (see this mod's seedreporterSettings.json to modify the existing star system filters)Exceptional officer pods, including the officer's skill setCoronal Hypershunts, including the defender variants

The seed string (followed by the relevant shorthands) will be automatically saved to

Starsector/saves/common/seedreporter_savedSeeds.json.data

- categorized by game version and current system date - if any of the following conditions are fulfilled:

{!TV} - all Coronal Hypershunts contain the same exact defender variants (note that there is no guarantee they will drop 4 of the same large weapon; physically defeating the defenders is still required to verify the drops!){!EO} - at least one combination of exceptional officer templates has been found{[any character]} - a star system filter with a specified "saveShorthand" contains at least one result

[close]

Caveats

Completely skipping the time-pass step during new game creation will result in a different Nameless Rock location than expected, as its location is normally determined after the time-pass step. If playing in modded games, the same is true for anything else that also generates after the time-pass step.The new game option to skip the time-pass step will not appear if a mod, such as Nexerelin, overrides the new game creation process.

[close]

descriptionHtml:
SEED Reporter

Requires Console Commands!

Includes LunaLib support
Safe to add to existing saves, and safe to remove from existing saves


Mod details

This utility mod adds the ability to display information about a sector seed upon loading a new game or when running the RunSEEDReport command on an existing save. The reported information includes the location of Coronal Hypershunts (and their defender variants), Domain-era Cryosleepers, exceptional officer pods, and even specific star systems or planets (via configurable search settings in this mod's seedreporterSettings.json).

Plus, this mod supports seed-hunting efforts by adding a new game option that completely bypasses the time-skip step - resulting in faster new game creation - and by automatically saving seeds with remarkable features to a file in Starsector's saves/common folder. A basic AutoHotkey script is included in the mod download to constantly create new games in Starsector without player intervention; combined with the automatic seed-saving, this mod will help you find your perfect seed in no time!*

*Targeted towards vanilla or vanilla-adjacent games; reliablity of seed information not guaranteed when running any mod that interferes with procedural generation!


Additional information (recommended to read!)Upon loading a new game, and using the original settings, the mod will provide information about the following points-of-interest (and more!):
  • Star system containing the Sentinel planet
  • Nameless Rock
  • Domain-era Cryosleepers
  • Domain-era Motherships
  • Fully-operational Remnant battlestations
  • Inactive Gates
  • Legion (XIV) wrecks
  • Star systems that fulfill specific criteria (see this mod's seedreporterSettings.json to modify the existing star system filters)
  • Exceptional officer pods, including the officer's skill set
  • Coronal Hypershunts, including the defender variants

The seed string (followed by the relevant shorthands) will be automatically saved to Starsector/saves/common/seedreporter_savedSeeds.json.data - categorized by game version and current system date - if any of the following conditions are fulfilled:
  • {!TV} - all Coronal Hypershunts contain the same exact defender variants (note that there is no guarantee they will drop 4 of the same large weapon; physically defeating the defenders is still required to verify the drops!)
  • {!EO} - at least one combination of exceptional officer templates has been found
  • {[any character]} - a star system filter with a specified "saveShorthand" contains at least one result
[close]
Caveats
  • Completely skipping the time-pass step during new game creation will result in a different Nameless Rock location than expected, as its location is normally determined after the time-pass step. If playing in modded games, the same is true for anything else that also generates after the time-pass step.
  • The new game option to skip the time-pass step will not appear if a mod, such as Nexerelin, overrides the new game creation process.
[close]
Latest changelogsv1.1.0
  • Seeds saved in the JSON file now also include the current system date in addition to the game version
  • Optimized "planetFilters" by not loading any unused planet filters
  • The exception message is now printed if the SEED report failed to write the seed to file
  • Commented out the "compressSaveGameData" setting in settings.json to avoid overriding the vanilla setting by default
  • The AutoHotkey script loop will now automatically reload (to stop the script) if Starsector was closed during execution
v1.0.0
  • Revamped SEED Report with multi-planet system search feature (implemented by brobinett)
    - Major changes to the "starSystemFilters" and "planetFilters" settings to allow searching for systems with multiple matching planets
    - Report no longer directly prints the "planetFilters" results; instead, "starSystemFilters" can now use planet filters to further filter out star systems
    - Added "starSystemFilterExecutionOrder" setting to avoid circular references with filter names
    - Consult the updated seedreporterSettings.json for further information on the new format!
  • Replaced "hasEntityWithTags" with "hasEntityWithMemoryKeys"
    - Now also allows searching for entities with specified memory keys, IDs, names, etc.
    - Tags can still be searched by appending "$tag:" to the desired tag (e.g., "$tag:gate" instead of "gate")
  • Fixed "maxHazardValue" option not properly taking the percentage value (fix by brobinett)
  • "planetFilters" now supports searching for star types (e.g., black holes or neutron stars)
  • Added error handling for SEED reports from "runSEEDReportOnGameStart" to avoid potential game crashes
  • Added error handling when generating the defenders for the Tesseract search
  • Star system filters with "saveShorthand" now also display their shorthand in the SEED report
  • Added more star system filters to seedreporterSettings.json
    - Also includes filters for finding certain modded content; these are disabled by default
  • Renamed default "hypershunt" filter to "coronalHypershunt"
  • Moved "runSEEDReportOnGameStart" setting to settings.json (from seedreporterSettings.json)
    - Done to allow this setting to load, even when seedreporterSettings.json cannot be loaded due to errors
  • Improved the AutoHotkey script
    - The script can now be toggled on/off using the backtick button
    - Starting the script also opens a GUI window as an activation reminder
    - Stopping the script now requires closing the GUI window (instead of pressing the Spacebar button)
v0.3.1
  • Fixed crash when a planet filter has no specified "avoidSystemTags"
  • Slight performance improvement when using "inStarSystemFilters"
  • SEED Report now prints the saved seed string (if any) to the console
v0.3.0
  • Overhauled the layout of the SEED report output
  • Replaced the hard-coded system search with the "starSystemFilters" setting in seedreporterSettings.json
    - Allows searching for star systems that fit a certain criteria
  • Added "tesseractStarSystemFilter" setting
    - Specifies which star system filter to use when searching for Tesseracts (should the Coronal Hypershunt filter be modified)
  • Replaced "saveSeedIfFound" option with "saveShorthand"
    - "saveShorthand" enables configuring the filter's shorthand when printing the seed
    - Having a filter (either planet or system) with a specified "saveShorthand" now saves the seed if a planet/system passes the filter
  • Added "avoidSystemTags" option for "planetFilters"
    - Replaces the hard-coded system tag filter for planets
  • Replaced "inGateSystem", "inDomainCryosleeperRange", and "inCoronalHypershuntRange" options with "inStarSystemFilters"
    - Allows searching for planets that are also either inside or near a filtered star system
  • Added "runSEEDReportOnGameStart" setting to seedreporterSettings.json
    - Can be set to "false" to disable automatically running a report upon starting a new game
  • Added LunaLib setting support
    - Only "runSEEDReportOnGameStart" is supported at this time
  • Fixed exceptional officer search not correctly handling combinations containing at least two different templates
  • Renamed "distanceFromCore" option to "distanceFromCOM"
    - Now uses the market center of mass calculation (instead of a hard-coded value) to determine distance
  • Significant code refactors
v0.2.0
  • Moved all SEED report config settings to seedreporterSettings.json (previously modSettings.json)
    - Renamed "planetsToSearch" to "planetFilters"
  • Added custom exceptional officer search settings to seedreporterSettings.json
    - These allow searching for specific template combinations (e.g., 2 slow High Tech officers and 2 fast High Tech ones)
    - The SEED report will now save the seed if any of the template combinations in "exceptionalOfficerSearch" are found
    - By default, seeds with 4-of-a-kind exceptional officer combinations are saved to "seedreporter_savedSeeds.json"
    - Seeds with no exceptional officer pods are no longer saved to the seed file
  • Modified the time-skip new game option to instead start with a Scarab and no additional officers
  • Normalized coordinates to the hyperspace grid size to simplify searching for systems in the hyperspace map
v0.1.0
  • Initial release
[close]

Credits
LazyWizard - For the Console Commands mod!
brobinett - For implementing the multi-planet system search feature
Starsector Forums - For the helpful modding tutorials and information
Unofficial Starsector Chat Discord - For the helpful modding information and tips
Alex and the Fractal Softworks team - For the amazing game that is Starsector!
